findings.title: The shelf plan does not say what its colours mean

location.description: The shelf plan in the hero panel.

findings.viewer_experience: A visitor sees green, white and one dark brown space without being told which means free, booked or theirs.

current.value: Three space states with no key.

findings.target: Each space state is named where the plan is shown.
findings.fix_direction: Add a short key beside the plan.
findings.source: Nielsen, 10 Usability Heuristics (visibility of system status)

closed_when.check: Looking at the plan, each colour has a stated meaning.

findings.title: The price at the foot of the panel has no context

location.description: The line under the plan that reads Space M4 and $18 paid.

findings.viewer_experience: A visitor does not know what the amount is for: this space, this firing, or the whole month.

current.value: One amount with the word paid and no period.

findings.target: The amount says what it covers.
findings.fix_direction: Name what the amount pays for.

closed_when.check: Looking at the line, the amount names what it covers.
